column1: # The known-failure list (#4689): shrink-only. Judged by scripts/release/known_failure_ratchet.sh,
# contract contracts/known-failure-ratchet-v1.yaml. Key = (model sha256, leg, check); a leg is a GPU
# architecture. Seed: the known failures fixed by the v0.70.1 release notes and tag, one row per
# (model, leg) each ticket names. Every one of them is still a failure: printed RED with its ticket.
# Delete a row when its ticket is fixed or re-ruled; never add one (a new failure needs a ruling).
